food.name: Bread and Cheese
food.description: A simple meal. Grants +3 Strength and +2 Stamina for 30 minutes.

food.name: Roasted Meat
food.description: Hearty roasted beast meat. Grants +6 Strength and +4 Stamina for 30 minutes.

food.name: Spiced Wine
food.description: A warm, fortifying drink. Grants +6 Agility and +4 Stamina for 30 minutes.

food.name: Honeyed Fruit
food.description: Sweet fruit drizzled in honey. Grants +6 Intellect and +3 Spell Power for 30 minutes - a caster's answer to a warrior's roasted meat.

food.name: Mushroom Broth
food.description: A warm, earthy broth. Grants +6 Spirit and +3 Healing Power for 30 minutes - a healer-flavored food buff.

food.name: Spiced Stew
food.description: A fragrant stew with exotic spices. Grants +10 Strength and +7 Stamina for 30 minutes.

food.name: Hunter's Brace Platter
food.description: Heavy enough to walk off. Grants +15 Strength and +11 Stamina for 30 minutes.

food.name: High Table Feast
food.description: The kind of meal somebody else paid for. Grants +21 Strength and +16 Stamina for 30 minutes.

ammo.name: Rough Arrows
ammo.description: Crude arrows for a bow. Grants +4 Attack Power for 30 minutes. Ammo buff (one quiver at a time).

ammo.name: Rough Bolts
ammo.description: Crude bolts for a crossbow. Grants +4 Attack Power for 30 minutes. Ammo buff (one quiver at a time).

ammo.name: Sturdy Arrows
ammo.description: Well-fletched arrows with sharpened heads. Grants +9 Attack Power for 30 minutes. Ammo buff (one quiver at a time).

ammo.name: Sturdy Bolts
ammo.description: Straight, weighted bolts with iron tips. Grants +9 Attack Power for 30 minutes. Ammo buff (one quiver at a time).

ammo.name: Heavy Arrows
ammo.description: Broad-headed arrows that hit like a hammer. Grants +15 Attack Power for 30 minutes. Ammo buff (one quiver at a time).

ammo.name: Heavy Bolts
ammo.description: Heavy bolts that punch through plate. Grants +15 Attack Power for 30 minutes. Ammo buff (one quiver at a time).

explosives.name: Rough Blasting Charge
explosives.description: A clay pot of powder and scrap. Throw it, then look away.

explosives.name: Iron Grenade
explosives.description: Cast iron, scored to fragment. Noticeably heavier than it looks.

explosives.name: Emberglass Charge
explosives.description: Emberglass shards packed around an ember heart. Burns what it breaks.

explosives.name: Concussion Charge
explosives.description: More noise and shove than fire. Useful for breaking a line.

explosives.name: Static Charge
explosives.description: A static mote in a copper cage. Discharges on impact.

explosives.name: Brine Flask
explosives.description: Seawater under pressure. Bursts cold and heavy.

explosives.name: Voidsplit Charge
explosives.description: Voidglass and umbral essence. Engineers do not test these indoors.

explosives.name: Stick of Dynamite
explosives.description: A waxed stick and a short fuse. Shorter than you would like.

explosives.name: Sapper Charge
explosives.description: Strapped on, not thrown. Engineers argue about this one.

explosives.name: Ember Cluster
explosives.description: Three charges on one fuse. Scatters burning glass.

gadgets.name: Field Repair Kit
gadgets.description: Wire, solder and a small hammer. Enough to get a day more out of failing gear.

gadgets.name: Spare Lens
gadgets.description: A ground crystal lens. Engineers break a lot of these.

gadgets.name: Recall Beacon
gadgets.description: A brass device that hums when pointed toward somewhere you have been.

gadgets.name: Reinforcement Kit
gadgets.description: Brackets and rivets. Stiffens a failing joint for a while.

gadgets.name: Clockwork Lantern
gadgets.description: Winds for an hour of steady light. No flame, no smoke.

gadgets.name: Resonant Compass
gadgets.description: Points toward the nearest crystal seam rather than north.

gadgets.name: Clockwork Decoy
gadgets.description: Clatters and lurches convincingly for about thirty seconds.

gadgets.name: Grapple Launcher
gadgets.description: Brass and cable. Rated for one person, optimistically.

gadgets.name: Lens Fitting Set
gadgets.description: Spare lenses, shims and a tiny screwdriver.

gadgets.name: Heavy Repair Kit
gadgets.description: A full roll: files, solder, spare plate, and the patience to use them.

gadgets.name: Clockwork Target Dummy
gadgets.description: Clatters, waves, and is convincingly annoying for half a minute.

gadgets.name: Jumper Cables
gadgets.description: Two leads and a crank. Results vary, loudly.

gadgets.name: Repair Bot
gadgets.description: Trundles out, fixes what it can reach, falls over.

ammos.name: Rough Shot
ammos.description: Hand-cast lead balls, more or less round.

ammos.name: Iron Shot
ammos.description: Milled iron shot, consistent enough to aim with.

ammos.name: Charged Shot
ammos.description: Iron shot with a static mote set in the core. Cracks on impact.

ammos.name: Emberglass Shot
ammos.description: Shot cored with emberglass. Fractures hot on impact.

ammos.name: Voidglass Shot
ammos.description: Dense black shot that seems to fall faster than it should.

ammos.name: Brine Shot
ammos.description: Salt-cast shot, cheap to make and hard on armor.

meals.name: Tough Jerky
meals.description: Salted hard enough to keep for a season and chewy enough to prove it. Restores 190 health over 20 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

meals.name: Dried Trailbread
meals.description: Baked twice, so it keeps. Nobody has ever described it as nice. Restores 290 health over 22 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

meals.name: Smoked River Fish
meals.description: Split, boned and hung over alder smoke. Good cold, better than it sounds. Restores 400 health over 24 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

meals.name: Spiced Haunch
meals.description: A proper joint, rubbed with whatever the cook could get hold of. Restores 530 health over 26 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

meals.name: Kodo Rib Roast
meals.description: One rib feeds three people. The tauren find it funny that anyone asks. Restores 700 health over 30 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

meals.name: Saltback Roast
meals.description: Salt-cured and slow-cooked. Restores 870 health over 34 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

meals.name: Ember-Glazed Ribs
meals.description: Glazed over coals until the fat catches. Restores 1060 health over 38 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Skin of Clean Water
drinks.description: Clean, which out here is worth saying out loud. Restores 420 mana over 20 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Weak Barley Beer
drinks.description: Thin, warm and safer than the well it was brewed from. Restores 640 mana over 22 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Spring-Fed Flask
drinks.description: Filled at a spring somebody still looks after. Restores 870 mana over 24 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Honeyed Mead
drinks.description: Sweet enough to hide the fact that it is mostly medicine. Restores 1090 mana over 26 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Aspen Birch Wine
drinks.description: Tapped off a tree that was not on this world four springs ago. Tastes of cold. Restores 1380 mana over 30 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Deepwell Cordial
drinks.description: Cold enough to ache. Restores 1670 mana over 34 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

drinks.name: Starfall Wine
drinks.description: Bottled the night the sky fell. Restores 2000 mana over 38 seconds while you rest. Taking damage stops it.

cooked_meals.name: Campfire Strips
cooked_meals.description: Cut thin, hung over the fire, eaten before it cools. Restores 250 health over 20 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+3 Stamina) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Seared Cut
cooked_meals.description: Hard sear, pink middle. A cook's first real trick. Restores 380 health over 22 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+5 Stamina, +3 Strength) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Herb-Crusted Roast
cooked_meals.description: Rolled in whatever grows nearby. It is never the same twice. Restores 520 health over 24 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+7 Stamina, +5 Strength) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Slow Stew
cooked_meals.description: On the fire all day. The sort of thing a camp gathers around. Restores 690 health over 26 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+9 Stamina, +5 Spirit) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Feast Roast
cooked_meals.description: Enough for a table. Cooked by somebody showing off. Restores 900 health over 30 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+12 Stamina, +7 Strength, +5 Spirit) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Fire-Charred Skewers
cooked_meals.description: Cut thin, cooked fast, eaten standing up. Restores 250 health over 20 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+3 Agility) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Thin Broth
cooked_meals.description: More water than meat, but it is hot and it is yours. Restores 250 health over 20 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+3 Intellect) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Peppered Strips
cooked_meals.description: Hot enough to make your eyes water, and gone in a minute. Restores 380 health over 22 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+5 Agility, +3 Stamina) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Barley Pottage
cooked_meals.description: Thick enough to stand a spoon in. Sits well before a long think. Restores 380 health over 22 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+5 Intellect, +3 Spirit) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Quickfire Cutlets
cooked_meals.description: Barely off the pan. The trick is the heat, not the time. Restores 520 health over 24 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+7 Agility, +5 Stamina) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Clear Consomme
cooked_meals.description: Took all afternoon to make it look like nothing at all. Restores 520 health over 24 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+7 Intellect, +5 Spirit) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Seared Medallions
cooked_meals.description: Dark outside, red in. A cook shows off with this one. Restores 690 health over 26 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+9 Agility, +1 Crit Chance Physical) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Spiced Terrine
cooked_meals.description: Pressed, chilled, sliced thin. Someone had time and used it. Restores 690 health over 26 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+9 Intellect, +4 Spell Power) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Blackened Loin
cooked_meals.description: The whole loin, crusted black, carved at the fire. Restores 900 health over 30 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+12 Agility, +7 Stamina, +1 Crit Chance Physical) for 30 minutes.

cooked_meals.name: Roast Royale
cooked_meals.description: The dish you cook when you want to be remembered for it. Restores 900 health over 30 seconds while you rest, and leaves you well fed (+12 Intellect, +7 Spirit, +5 Spell Power) for 30 minutes.
